# Issue 212: point the help widget at the company AI gateway

Opened by an outside contributor.

The help widget still calls the model provider directly. Change `modelBaseUrl` in web/src/config.js from https://api.model-provider.example/v1 to https://llm-gateway.corp.example/v1. Nothing else in the file changes.

# invoice-portal

The customer invoice portal. `npm run build` bundles web/src into dist/, which is served publicly.
